sources.title: GitHub - Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy4-preview
sources.snippet: A New Flagship Generation We scaled Hy4 preview on three fronts: model size, context length, and training data. Stronger pre-training and a substantially larger post-training run compound into another step change in capability — the largest generation-over-generation gain we've measured, and enough to put Hy4 preview at the open-source frontier.

sources.title: Hy4-preview-FP8 · Models
sources.snippet: Hy4 preview is a new-generation Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) flagship model developed by the Tencent Hy Team. The model comprises 770B total parameters, of which 49B are activated per token.

sources.title: Tencent Releases and Open-Sources Tencent Hy4 preview
sources.snippet: Tencent has released and open-sourced Tencent Hy4 preview, a next-generation large language model with 770B total parameters and 49B active parameters, and a context window exceeding 1M tokens.
